articles.title: A Monkey's Silvery Fur May Explain Its Link to a Moon God
articles.summary: A new study says a baboon's silvery fur closely matches moonlight, which may explain why ancient Egyptians linked the animal to Thoth, the moon god.

articles.title: Knee Surgery Rules Sinner Out of the Australian Open
articles.summary: Jannik Sinner has had knee surgery and will miss the Australian Open in January, but he hopes to return for AO 2028.

articles.title: The Mineral Detective Solving Big Problems With Rocks
articles.summary: Aaron Celestian studies minerals at a Los Angeles museum and uses them to solve big problems, from cleaning dirty water to finding new cures for diseases.
